Nau sau saal sada-e-b-sahra ke baad bhi ek paighambarana koshish yahan bayan ho raha hai ke saadhay nau sau saal tak ki lambi muddat mein kis kis tarah Hazrat Nuh Nabi ne apni kaum ko rushd-o-hidayat ki taraf bulaya, kaum ne kis kis tarah a'raz kiya, kaisi kaisi takleefen Allah ke pyare paighambar ko pahunchain aur kis tarah apni zidd par ad gaye, to Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam bator shikayat ke janab-e-bari mein arz karte hain ke Ilahi main ne tere hukm ki poori tarah sargrami se ta'amil ki, tere farman-e-aalishan ke mutabiq na din ko din samjha, na raat ko raat, balki musalsal har waqt unhein rah-e-rast ki dawat deta raha lekin kya karun ke jis dil-sozi se main unhein neki ki taraf bulata raha woh usi sakhti se mujh se bhagte rahe haq se rogardani karte rahe, yahan tak hua ke main ne unhein kaha aao Rabb ki suno taake Rabb tumhein bakhsh-e lekin unhon ne mere un alfaaz ka sunna bhi gawara na kiya, kaan band kar liye, yehi haal kuffar-e-Quresh ka tha ke Kalamullah ko sunna bhi pasand nahi karte the jaise irshad hai aayat (Wa qalal-lazina kafaru la tasma'u li-hazal-qur'ani wal-ghaw fihi la'allakum taghlibun) 41. (Fussilat: 26) yaani kafiron ne kaha is Quran ko na suno aur jab yeh padha jata ho to shor-o-ghal karo taake tum ghalib raho, kaum-e-Nuh ne jahan apne kaano mein ungliyan dalin wahan apne munh kapron se chhupa liye taake woh pehchane bhi na jayen aur na kuch sune apne shirk-o-kufr par zidd ke sath ad gaye aur ittiba-e-haq se na sirf inkar kar diya balki isse be-parwahi ki aur ise haqeer jaan kar takabbur se peeth pher li, Hazrat Nuh farmate hain aam logon ke majma' mein bhi main ne unhein kaha suna ba-awaz-e-buland unke kaan khol diye aur basa auqat ek ek ko chupke chupke bhi samjhaya gharz tamam jatan kar liye ke yun nahi yun samajh jayen aur yun nahi to yun rah-e-rast par aa jayen, main ne unhein kaha ke kam az kam tum apni badkariyon se tauba hi kar lo woh Allah Ghaffar hai har jhukne wale ki taraf tawajjah farmata hai aur khwah usse kaise hi bad se badtar aamal sar zad hue hon ek aan mein maaf farma deta hai, yehi nahi balki duniya mein bhi woh tumhein tumhare istighfar ki wajah se tarah tarah ki na'maten ata farmayega aur dard-o-dukh se bacha lega woh tum par khoob musaldhaar barish barsayega. Yeh yaad rahe ke qaht-sali ke mauqe par jab namaz-e-istisqa ke liye musalman niklein to mustahab hai ke is namaz mein is surat ko padhein, iski ek daleel to yehi aayat hai dusre Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar Farooq Razi Allahu Anhu ka fa'il bhi yehi hai. Aap se marwi hai ke barish mangne ke liye jab aap nikle to minbar par chadh kar aap ne khoob istighfar kiya aur istighfar wali ayaton ki tilawat ki, jin mein ek aayat yeh bhi thi. Phir farmane lage ke barish ko main ne barish ki tamam rahon se jo asman mein hain talab kar liya hai yaani woh ahkam ada kiye hain, jin se Allah barish nazil farmaya karta hai.

Hazrat Nuh farmate hain ke ae meri kaum ke logo tum agar istighfar karoge toh barish ke sath hi sath rizq ki barkat bhi tumhe milegi, zameen-o-asman ki barkaton se tum mala maal hojaoge, khetiyan khoob hongi, janwaron ke than doodh se pur rahenge, maal-o-aulad mein taraqqi hogi, qism qism ke phalon se lade phande baghat tumhe naseeb honge jin ke darmiyan charon taraf aur babarkat pani ki rail peel hogi, har taraf nahrein aur darya jari hojayenge. Is tarah raghib dila kar phir zara khauf-zada bhi karte hain aur farmate hain tum Allah ki azmat ke qayil kyun nahi hote? Uske azab se be-bak kyun hogaye ho? Dekhte nahi ke Allah ne tumhe kin kin halaton mein kis kis tarah halat badal badal kar sath paida kiya hai? Pehle pani ki boond phir jamid khoon phir gosht ka lothra phir aur soorat phir aur halat waghera, isi tarah dekho toh sahi ke us ne ek par ek is tarah asman paida kiye khwah woh sirf sunne se hi maloom hue hon ya un wujooh se maloom hue hon jo mehsoos hain jo sitaron ki chal aur un ke kusoof se samjhi ja sakti hain jaise ke is ilm walon ka bayan hai go is mein bhi un ka sakht tar ikhtilaf hai ke kawakib chalne phirne wale bare bare saat hain. Ek ek ko be-noor kardeta hai, sab se qareeb asman-e-dunya mein chand hai jo doosron ko mand kiye hue hai aur doosre asman par utarid hai, teesre mein zuhra hai, chothe mein sooraj hai, panchwein mein mareekh hai, chhate mein mushtari, satwein mein zuhal aur baqi kawakib jo thawabit hain woh athwein mein hain jis ka naam yeh log falak-e-thawabit rakhte hain aur un mein se jo shara wale hain woh ise kursi kehte hain aur nawan falak un ke nazdeek atlas aur asheer hai jis ki harkat un ke khayal mein aflak ki harkat ke khilaf hai is liye ke darasal is ki harkat aur harkaton ka mabda hai woh maghrib se mashriq ki taraf harkat karta hai aur baqi sab asman mashriq se maghrib ki taraf aur unhi ke sath kawakib bhi ghoomte phirte rehte hain, lekin sayyaron ki harkat aflak ki harkat ke bilkul bar-aks hai woh sab maghrib se mashriq ki taraf harkat karte hain aur un mein ka har ek apne asman ka pheer apne maqdoor ke mutabiq karta hai, chand toh har mah mein ek bar, sooraj har saal mein ek bar, zuhal har tees saal mein ek martaba.

Muddat ki yeh kami beshi ba-itibar aasman ki lambai chaudai ke hai warna sab ki harkat sur'at mein bilkul munasibat rakhti hai, yeh khulasah hai un ki tamam tar baaton ka jis mein un mein aapas mein bhi bahut kuch ikhtilaf hai na hum usay yahan warid karna chahte hain na us ki tahqeeq-o-taftish se us waqt koi gharz hai maqsood sirf is qadr hai ke Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne saat aasman banaye hain aur woh ooper tale hain, phir un mein sooraj chand paida kiya hai, dono ki chamak damak aur roshni aur ujala alag alag hai jis se din raat ki tameez hojati hai, phir chand ki muqarrarah manzilein aur buroj hain phir us ki roshni ghutti barhti rehti hai aur aisa waqt bhi aata hai ke woh bilkul chup jata hai aur aisa waqt bhi aata hai ke woh apni poori roshni ke sath namoodar hota hai jis se mahine aur saal maloom hote hain, jaise farman hai ayat (Huwal-lazii ja'alasy-shamsa diyaa-anw-wal-qamara nooranw-wa qaddarahu manaazila lita'lamoo 'adadas-sineena wal-hisaaba ma khalaqal-laha zalika illa bil-haqqi yufassilul-aayaati li-qawmin ya'lamoon) (Yunus: 5) Allah woh hai jis ne sooraj, chand khoob roshan chamakdar banaye aur chand ki manzilein muqarrar kardeen taqke tumhein saal aur hisab maloom hojayein un ki paidaish haq ke sath hai. Aalimon ke samne Allah ki qudrat ke yeh namonay alag alag mojood hain, phir farmaya Allah ne tumhein zameen se ugaya is masdar ne mazmoon ko behad lateef kardiya phir tumhein maar dalne ke baad usi mein lautayega, phir qayamat ke din usi se tumhein nikale ga, jaise awwal dafaa paida kiya tha aur Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko tumhara farsh banadiya aur woh hilay jale nahi is liye us par mazboot pahad gaar diye, usi zameen ke kushadah raston par tum chalte phirte ho usi par rehte sehte ho udhar se udhar jate aate ho, gharz Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ki har mumkin koshish yeh hai ke azmat-e-Rab aur qudrat-e-Allah ke namonay apni kaum ke samne rakh kar unhein samjha rahe hain ke zameen-o-aasman ki barkaton ke dene wale har cheez ke paida karne wale aali shan qudrat ke rakhne wale raaziq khaliq Allah ka kya tum par itna bhi haq nahi ke tum usay poojo us ka lihaz rakho aur us ke kehne se us ke sache Nabi ki rah ikhtiyar karo, tumhein zaroor chahiye ke sirf usi ki ibadat karo kisi aur ko na poojo, us jaisa us ka shareek, us ka sajhi, us ka maseel kisi ko na jano, usay biwi aur maan se, beton poton, wazeer-o-mushir se, adeel-o-natheer se paak mano usi ko buland bala usi ko azeem-o-aala jano.

Yeh yaad rahe ke qaht-sali ke mauqe par jab namaz-e-istisqa ke liye musalman niklein to mustahab hai ke is namaz mein is surat ko padhein, iski ek daleel to yehi aayat hai dusre Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar Farooq Razi Allahu Anhu ka fa'il bhi yehi hai. Aap se marwi hai ke barish mangne ke liye jab aap nikle to minbar par chadh kar aap ne khoob istighfar kiya aur istighfar wali ayaton ki tilawat ki, jin mein ek aayat yeh bhi thi. Ek ek ko be-noor kardeta hai, sab se qareeb asman-e-dunya mein chand hai jo doosron ko mand kiye hue hai aur doosre asman par utarid hai, teesre mein zuhra hai, chothe mein sooraj hai, panchwein mein mareekh hai, chhate mein mushtari, satwein mein zuhal aur baqi kawakib jo thawabit hain woh athwein mein hain jis ka naam yeh log falak-e-thawabit rakhte hain aur un mein se jo shara wale hain woh ise kursi kehte hain aur nawan falak un ke nazdeek atlas aur asheer hai jis ki harkat un ke khayal mein aflak ki harkat ke khilaf hai is liye ke darasal is ki harkat aur harkaton ka mabda hai woh maghrib se mashriq ki taraf harkat karta hai aur baqi sab asman mashriq se maghrib ki taraf aur unhi ke sath kawakib bhi ghoomte phirte rehte hain, lekin sayyaron ki harkat aflak ki harkat ke bilkul bar-aks hai woh sab maghrib se mashriq ki taraf harkat karte hain aur un mein ka har ek apne asman ka pheer apne maqdoor ke mutabiq karta hai, chand toh har mah mein ek bar, sooraj har saal mein ek bar, zuhal har tees saal mein ek martaba.

Muddat ki yeh kami beshi ba-itibar aasman ki lambai chaudai ke hai warna sab ki harkat sur'at mein bilkul munasibat rakhti hai, yeh khulasah hai un ki tamam tar baaton ka jis mein un mein aapas mein bhi bahut kuch ikhtilaf hai na hum usay yahan warid karna chahte hain na us ki tahqeeq-o-taftish se us waqt koi gharz hai maqsood sirf is qadr hai ke Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne saat aasman banaye hain aur woh ooper tale hain, phir un mein sooraj chand paida kiya hai, dono ki chamak damak aur roshni aur ujala alag alag hai jis se din raat ki tameez hojati hai, phir chand ki muqarrarah manzilein aur buroj hain phir us ki roshni ghutti barhti rehti hai aur aisa waqt bhi aata hai ke woh bilkul chup jata hai aur aisa waqt bhi aata hai ke woh apni poori roshni ke sath namoodar hota hai jis se mahine aur saal maloom hote hain, jaise farman hai ayat (Huwal-lazii ja'alasy-shamsa diyaa-anw-wal-qamara nooranw-wa qaddarahu manaazila lita'lamoo 'adadas-sineena wal-hisaaba ma khalaqal-laha zalika illa bil-haqqi yufassilul-aayaati li-qawmin ya'lamoon) (Yunus: 5) Allah woh hai jis ne sooraj, chand khoob roshan chamakdar banaye aur chand ki manzilein muqarrar kardeen taqke tumhein saal aur hisab maloom hojayein un ki paidaish haq ke sath hai. Nuh Alaihis Salam ki bargah-e-Ilahi mein rudad-e-gham. Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apni guzishta shikayaton ke sath hi Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein apni kaum ke logon ki is rawash ko bhi bayan kiya ke meri pukar ko jo un ke liye sarasar nafa bakhsh thi unhon ne kaan tak na lagaya haan apne maaldaron aur be-fikron ki maan li jo tere amr se bilkul ghafil the aur maal-o-aulad ke peeche mast thi, go fi-waqai woh maal-o-aulad bhi un ke liye sarasar wabaal-e-jaan thi, kyunke un ki wajah se woh phoolte the aur Allah ko bhoolte the aur zyada nuqsan mein utarte jate the. (Waladahu) ki doosri qirat (waladahu) bhi hai aur un raeeson ne jo maal-o-jah wale the un se bari makkari ki. (Kubbari) aur (Kibbar) dono maana mein Kabir ke hain yaani bahut bara. Qiyamat ke din bhi yeh log yahin kahenge ke tum din raat makkari se hamein kufr aur shirk ka hukum karte rahe aur inhi baro ne in choton se kaha ke apne in buton ko jinhen tum poojte rahe hargiz na chorna. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke kaum-e-Nuh ke buton ko kuffar-e-Arab ne le liya, Dumatul Jundal mein qabila Kalb Wadd ko poojte the, Huzail qabila Suwa' ka parastar tha aur qabila Murad phir qabila Banu Ghataif jo Saraff ke rehne wale the yeh shehar Saba basti ke pas hai Yaghouth ki puja karta tha, Hamlan qabila Ya'qub ka pujari tha, Aal-e-Zhi Kula' ka qabila Himyar Nasr but ka manne wala tha, yeh sab but darasal kaum-e-Nuh ke saleh buzurg Auliya Allah log the un ke inteqal ke baad Shaitan ne us zamane ke logon ke dilon mein dali ke in buzurgon ki ibadat-gahon mein un ki koi yaadgar qaim karein, chunacha unhon ne wahan nishan bana diye aur har buzurg ke naam par unhen mashhoor kiya, jab tak yeh log zinda rahe tab tak to us jagah ki parastish na hui lekin un nishanat aur yaadgar qaim karne wale logon ko marjane ke baad aur ilm ke uth jane ke baad jo log aaye jahalat ki wajah se unhon ne baqaida un jagahon ki aur un namon ki puja-paat shuru kar di. Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Zahhak, Hazrat Qatadah, Hazrat Ibn Ishaq bhi yahi farmate hain.

Hazrat Muhammad bin Qais farmate hain yeh buzurg abid, Allah wale, Awliyaullah, Hazrat Adam, aur Hazrat Noah ke sachche tab-e-farman saleh log the jin ki pairwi aur log bhi karte the jab yeh mar gaye to un ke muqtadiyon ne kaha ke agar hum in ki tasveerein bana lein toh humein ibadat mein khoob dilchaspi rahegi aur in buzurgon ki soortein dekh kar shauq-e-ibadat barhta rahega, chunancha aisa hi kiya. Jab yeh log bhi mar khap gaye aur un ki naslein aayin toh Shaitan ne unhein yeh ghutti pilayi ke tumhare barhe un ki puja-paat karte the aur unhi se barish waghera mangte the, chunancha unhon ne ab baqaida in buzurgon ki tasveeron ki parastish shuru kar di. 

Hafiz Ibn Asakir (Rahimahullah) Hazrat Shees (Alaihis Salam) ke qisse mein bayan karte hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ne farmaya: Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ke chalis bachche the, bees larke, bees larkiyan, un mein se jin ki barhi umrein huin un mein Habil, Qabil, Saleh aur Abdur Rahman the jin ka pehla naam Abdul Harith tha, aur Wadd tha, jinhein Shees aur Hibbatullah bhi kaha jata hai. Tamam bhaiyon ne sardari unhi ko de rakhi thi. In ki aulad yeh charon the yaani Suwa, Yaghouth, Yaouq aur Nasr. 

Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair farmate hain ke Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki bimari ki quwwat un ki aulad Wadd, Yaghouth, Yaouq, Suwa aur Nasr thi. Wadd un sab mein barha aur sab se naik sulook karne wala tha. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Abu Ja'far (Rahimahullah) namaz parh rahe the aur logon ne Zaid bin Muhallab ka zikr kiya, aap ne farigh ho kar farmaya: Suno, woh wahan qatl kiya gaya jahan ab se pehle ghairullah ki parastish hui. Waqia yeh hua ke ek deendar Waliullah musalman, jise log bahut chahte the aur barhe motaqid the, woh mar gaya. Yeh log mujawir ban kar us ki qabr par baith gaye aur rona-peetna aur use yaad karna shuru kiya aur barhe bechain aur museebat-zada ho gaye. Iblees-e-La'een ne yeh dekh kar insani soorat mein un ke pas aa kar un se kaha ke is buzurg ki yaadgar kyun qayam nahi kar lete? Jo har waqt tumhare samne rahe aur tum use na bhulo. Sab ne is raye ko pasand kiya. Iblees ne us buzurg ki tasveer bana kar un ke pas khari kar di, jise dekh dekh kar yeh log use yaad karte the aur us ki ibadat ke tazkare rehte the.
